name: Backups
tagline: Protects a folder with snapshots you can put back

offers.label: Look again
offers.description: Looks at the repository again: the source, the destination and the snapshots it holds.

offers.label: Keep catalog
offers.description: Keeps what the device answered about its repository, so the window and an agent read the

offers.label: Back up now
offers.description: Backs the folder up now, keeping what the retention policy keeps.

offers.label: Begin restore
offers.description: Starts finding the folder a restore writes into, without running anything yet.

offers.label: Stop the work
offers.description: Stops the work under way; what it was writing goes.

offers.label: Order
offers.description: Lists the timeline newest first, or oldest first.

offers.label: Show the place
offers.description: Shows one of the sidebar's places.

offers.label: Keep one more
offers.description: Keeps one more snapshot of a class.

offers.label: Keep one fewer
offers.description: Keeps one fewer snapshot of a class.

offers.label: Dismiss
offers.description: Dismisses the line under the list.

offers.label: Choose the folder to protect
offers.description: Asks the person which folder this device protects.

offers.label: Choose where snapshots go
offers.description: Asks the person where the snapshots go.

offers.label: Go
offers.description: Walks the picker to another folder and shows the folders in it.

offers.label: Go up
offers.description: Walks the picker up one folder.

offers.label: Use this folder
offers.description: Takes the folder the picker shows: as what this device protects, where snapshots go, or

offers.label: Cancel
offers.description: Leaves the picker without changing anything.

offers.label: Read picker
offers.description: Reads the folders of the one the picker shows.

offers.label: Start work
offers.description: Starts a piece of work and keeps the job the device gave it.
